name: table_lookup_no_defense
source_inspiration: Base leakage case: secret-dependent table lookup maps different secret values to attacker-monitored cache sets.

name: table_lookup_constant_time_scan
source_inspiration: Constant-time access mitigation for table lookup: access all candidate locations regardless of the secret.

name: table_lookup_random_padding
source_inspiration: Random padding mitigation for table lookup: add random extra memory accesses, but keep the original secret-dependent access.

name: table_lookup_partitioned_cache
source_inspiration: Cache partitioning-style mitigation for table lookup: attacker monitors sets 0-3, while secret-dependent victim accesses are mapped to sets 4-7.

name: multi_table_no_defense
source_inspiration: Base leakage case: table-driven code touches multiple secret-dependent table entries, creating a wider cache footprint.

name: multi_table_constant_time_footprint
source_inspiration: Constant-time mitigation for multi-table lookup: touch all candidate table footprints in a fixed order regardless of the real secret.

name: branch_no_defense
source_inspiration: Base leakage case: a secret-dependent branch touches one of two code/data regions, leaking the branch direction.

name: branch_balanced_footprint
source_inspiration: Balanced-footprint mitigation for secret-dependent branch: touch both branch regions in a fixed order regardless of which branch is logically selected.

name: loop_count_no_defense
source_inspiration: Base leakage case: the number of memory locations touched depends on secret + 1.

name: loop_count_fixed_count_padding
source_inspiration: Fixed-count mitigation for secret-dependent loop count: always touch a fixed number of locations, independent of the secret.
